title: Large-diffusion dynamics for a planar Neumann heat equation with exponential nonlinearity
summary: We study the Neumann problem $u_t-\varepsilonΔu=e^u-1-au\ (a>1)$ on a smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^2$. For the spatially homogeneous problem, $0$ is stable, the positive equilibrium $ξ_a$ is unstable, and solutions starting above $ξ_a$ blow up in finite time. Although finite-time blow-up persists at every diffusivity, we show that sufficiently large diffusion recovers this scalar trichotomy uniformly on every bounded $H^1$ ball, and that blow-up occurs precisely when the spatial mean crosses $ξ_a$.
